olga_cs: Quick drop: creating a short 'activation signal' playbook for CSMs — one-paragraph + 6-bullet checklist. Goal: pasteable into kickoff and ticket. Feedback?

mike_sre: +1. Keep it small. Add exact triage triggers we use so SRE gets consistent info.

olga_cs: draft paragraph (pasteable):
'Activation Signal Playbook: If customers show activation friction (demo failures, repeated slow responses, or accuracy complaints) follow this mini-runbook: run quick health checks, enable client streaming fallback, tune prefill TTL to idle, apply short-term mitigations (bump prefill pool / add batch workers / enable safe-fallback), capture 3 example prompts and VOC, and escalate using the SRE ticket template with logs and samples.'

nora_se: Nice. CSM checklist bullets please — super short.

olga_cs: checklist (pasteable):
- confirm last 24h success rate >= 98% and 95p latency < SLA target
- verify prefill enabled; TTL tuned to expected idle (default 30s)
- ensure streaming endpoint enabled for demos; add client fallback snippet
- collect 3 sample prompts + expected outputs + one screenshot if failure
- mitigation: bump prefill pool & enable safe-fallback; notify SRE if >2 incidents in 48h
- VOC: send 3-question pulse after go-live (latency ok?, accuracy ok?, top flows?)

mike_sre: adding triage triggers & quick queries to paste in ticket: 
```
# triage triggers (pasteable)
if (activation_errors >= 2 in 48h) -> open SRE ticket
if (95p_latency > SLA * 1.5 for 24h) -> open SRE ticket
# quick queries (pseudocode)
err_rate = query("sum(rate(request_errors[30m])) by (tenant)
lat95 = query("histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(latency_bucket[1h])) by (le))")
prefill_hit = query("sum(prefill_hits) / sum(prefill_requests)")
```

eli_pm: add RenewalRisk rule: auto-tag when (>=3 activation incidents in 30d) OR (VOC pulse negative twice in 14d). CSM must review before outreach.

olga_cs: done. also pasting client fallback snippet for enablement emails (one-liner pseudocode):
```
if (client.streamAvailable()) { useStream(); } else if (prefill.ready()) { usePrefill(); } else { callSync(); }
```
